name: @cairnfield/index
description: Index Worker: builds one validated view per component commit and lists its components, and serves a page that draws each.

scripts.typecheck: npm run types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/page/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p src/page/tsconfig.json && cp src/page/root.html src/page/page.html src/page/styles.css src/page/favicon.ico src/page/favicon.svg src/page/apple-touch-icon.png dist/page/ && mkdir dist/page/fonts && cp src/page/fonts/*.woff2 src/page/fonts/*.ttf dist/page/fonts/ && ls dist/page/root.html dist/page/page.html dist/page/styles.css dist/page/poll.js dist/page/map.js dist/page/render.js dist/page/favicon.ico dist/page/favicon.svg dist/page/apple-touch-icon.png dist/page/fonts/routed-gothic.ttf dist/page/fonts/hanken-grotesk.woff2 dist/page/fonts/spline-sans-mono.woff2
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --var "GIT_URLS:${GIT_URLS:?set GIT_URLS to the Git URLs this index may import, with a space between two}" ${CLAIM_TTL_SECONDS:+--var CLAIM_TTL_SECONDS:$CLAIM_TTL_SECONDS}
